notes.title: Dino Quake Update Plans & Thanks!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Dino Quake has officially launched and I just wanted to say a big THANK YOU to all of you who played it and shared your thoughts!

We've passed 20 reviews already and your feedback means a lot. If you enjoyed the game and haven't left a review yet please consider doing so: it really helps spread the word and support indie games like this one 🦖


What’s next?
I'm already planning a free content update to bring more action and surprises to Dino Quake. More details soon!


Thanks again for playing and being part of this quake-powered adventure!
Stay tuned, the ground will shake again soon. 💥

notes.title: Dino Quake DEMO Now Available!
notes.content:
Get ready to stomp, quake, and kick enemies, the Dino Quake demo is now live! Try out the first taste of dino-powered chaos in this retro-inspired arcade platformer and wishlist the game.

Demo includes:

 One playable dinosaur
 6 stages
 Single mode
 Gamepad support
